reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

vote_frequency.label: In this cached set only (the latest 40 House roll calls, not a lifetime record): 40 of 40. Yea or Aye: 34. Nay or No: 6. Not Voting: 0. Of 40 Yea or Nay votes where the Republican majority could be computed, 39 (98%) matched that majority (majority = the side most of that party's members voting Yea or Nay took; on average 210 members of that party voted Yea or Nay per roll call).

stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

Rural healthcare professionals play a vital role in ensuring that families can access the care they need close to home.

As we approach National Rural Health Day, learn more about my work to strengthen rural healthcare in Nebraska:
https://t.co/3gghhOiSDq

The North Platte Canteen embodies the very best of Nebraska: patriotism, sacrifice, and devotion to community.

When it comes to healthcare, one size does not fit all, and patients deserve to have choices. 

I introduced my bipartisan BRIDGE Care at Home Act with @RepDebDingell to modernize Medicare and give beneficiaries more control over their care options.
https://t.co/FflRKEiil8

Good morning! 

Looking forward to joining @MarkieMartin on @NewsNations Mornings in America today at 7:25 am CT/6:25 MT. 

Tune in NOW to watch it LIVE! https://t.co/NevJPC98iA

Yesterday, I met with members of @vfwne to discuss how we can continue working together to support Veterans across our state.

Thank you for your service and all that you do to support those who have sacrificed so much for our freedom! https://t.co/nU7UrA2KY1
This Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who have served our nation with unwavering dedication, sacrifice, and patriotism. https://t.co/y21fmEOuqd

Congratulations to our new Republican Leader @Jim_Jordan, Whip @GOPMajorityWhip, Conference Chair @RepLisaMcClain, NRCC Chair @RepBrianJack, Conference Secretary @RepMarkAlford, Conference Vice Chair @RepBlakeMoore, and Republican Policy Committee Chair @JayObernolte!

Thank you

The world’s greatest experiment endures and thrives because of the extraordinary sacrifices generations of veterans have made. 

This Veterans Day, please join me in thanking our nation’s heroes and taking the time to show them our sincere gratitude.
https://t.co/s8GQ0d7bd2

Honored to join the @NPChamber at their annual meeting last week! I look forward to continuing to work together to ensure that North Platte remains a great place to live, work, and raise a family! https://t.co/4juU60Zo7j

Nebraskans have always been problem solvers, innovators, and out-of-the-box thinkers who get the job done. That is why we will play a key role in advancing America's energy independence.

Learn about my work to support these efforts in my latest column:
https://t.co/QPRBYFMvbv

I created my Youth Advisory Council to give young Nebraskans across the Third District a chance to exchange ideas, hear different perspectives, and learn about public service and civic engagement.

Meet the students selected to serve on my 2026–2027 Youth Advisory Council:
Happy National First Responders Day! To all those who run toward danger and work tirelessly to keep us and our communities safe, thank you. https://t.co/YA5Ybnp8bO

RESCHEDULED: The mobile office hour my staff had scheduled for October 28, 2026, in Blaine County has been rescheduled for Wednesday, November 25, 2026. 

I apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.
https://t.co/pbB1lFvKC0

My staff will be hosting a mobile office hour tomorrow, October 28th, for constituents in Wheeler County. 

If you have thoughts to share or need assistance with a federal agency, please stop by to see how my office can help!
https://t.co/0ig7hr0370

Manufacturing is a driving force behind Nebraska's economy. During #NationalManufacturingMonth, learn how I’m working to support Nebraska manufacturers, strengthen domestic supply chains, and create opportunities for growth in my latest column.
https://t.co/IfJfje3jQQ

It was great to stop by the Family Advocacy Network in Kearney for a tour of their new facility and to discuss their latest efforts to support children and families facing difficult circumstances. 

I appreciated learning more about their mission and the difference they're making https://t.co/Zfa20s8NIW

Every child deserves the love, stability, and support of a family. This year, I had the pleasure of honoring Jenna and Robert Stoner of Holdrege as Nebraska's Third District @CCAInstitute Angels in Adoption Honorees. 

Thank you for being a powerful example of the care and https://t.co/lPUGMDWldE

Congratulations to @BDandCo on 60 years in Holdrege! 

For six decades, BD has been a valued partner in the Holdrege community—creating quality jobs and supporting the local economy. I enjoyed being part of the celebration and recognizing this milestone! https://t.co/qzCJ6h05tL

Great discussion with @SecretaryWright, @NEFarmBureau, and Nebraska agriculture leaders on strengthening America’s energy independence.

From 45Z to nationwide, year-round E15, I’ll keep fighting for policies that expand markets for Nebraska biofuels, support our farmers, and deliver affordable, homegrown energy.

Great to have @SecretaryWright in the Good Life!

Thank you for joining us to celebrate a momentous milestone for @NioCorp's Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project and an important roundtable discussion with @NEFarmBureau. https://t.co/DxkRO7vRqo

In Nebraska, we’re used to putting miles on the car. But when those miles mean traveling for a doctor’s appointment or medical treatment, distance can be a real challenge for rural families

In my latest column, I share highlights from @DrOzCMS’s visit to the Third District and my work to bring care closer to home.
https://t.co/glVrrj7BOq

Looking forward to joining @NewsNation's Morning in America with @MarkieMartin at 6:15 am CT/5:15 am MT. 

Tune in NOW to watch my interview LIVE! https://t.co/zJtFRMo2op

Nebraskans work hard for every dollar. 

Fraudsters shouldn’t get to steal a dime.

Today, I signed @VP Vance’s Pledge to Protect Americans from Fraud because protecting hardworking Americans should be common sense, not controversial. https://t.co/QhgM0FNdeE

I appreciate @POTUS and @epaleezeldin for their continued support of American biofuels and for taking action to strengthen our nation’s energy independence. 

Today’s announcement is welcome news for America's biofuel producers, providing the certainty they need to grow our homegrown energy industry. This also marks an important victory for our farmers, rural communities, and American consumers looking for lower prices at the pump.
To the men and women who feed and fuel our world, happy National Farmer’s Day! https://t.co/1fdmqnMQrM

Honored to welcome @DrOzCMS to the Good Life yesterday to visit Memorial Community Hospital in Blair!

We had a great discussion about the needs of rural healthcare providers and ways we can work together to ensure every Nebraskan has access to quality care close to home. https://t.co/65JyefDC0k

Pleased to see Governor Hochul opt into my Federal Scholarship Tax Credit which I fought to secure in the @TaxCuts to expand educational opportunities for ALL families. 

Let me be clear—taking advantage of my tax credit is common sense, not a political debate. https://t.co/upqB0NEPIM

Today, I led a letter with @RepNikkiB and 37 colleagues urging @EPALeeZeldin and @SecretaryWright to build on the admin’s historic support for American biofuels by issuing a supplemental rule that provides much-needed certainty for biofuel producers and consumers.

Read more⬇️
https://t.co/yapymgPRQv

Fans expect college athletics to be played the right way. 

Unfortunately, as they have evolved over the last few years, there have been well-documented cases nationwide of players and coaches trying to go beyond the spirit of the sport.

That's why I introduced my Fair Play Enforcement Act to address these concerns and keep college athletics on a level playing field. Read more in my column this week: 
https://t.co/dFcmKjWBEd

On October 7, 2023, Hamas terrorists carried out a barbaric attack against Israel and its people. 

Today, we mourn the innocent lives that were lost and reaffirm our commitment to fighting antisemitism wherever it exists. https://t.co/oHupv3jrpU

posts.text: I am eager to see this project advance through the permitting process and look forward to working with the administration to expand the production of American-made fertilizer while creating new jobs and opportunities for Nebraska's Third District! https://t.co/58NA4g47sc

Every child deserves the love, stability, and support of a family.

In my latest column, I highlight Jenna and Robert Stoner of Holdrege, this year’s Angels in Adoption honorees for Nebraska’s Third District, and my latest efforts to support Nebraska families at every stage.
https://t.co/QYQPFry50U

Hard work should pay off. 

That’s why I supported the Working Families Tax Cuts — putting real relief back in the hands of working families. https://t.co/HaXoqQr01U

Today I sat down with members of the Alzheimer’s Association in Scottsbluff to hear firsthand about the devastating impact of this disease on individuals, families and the community.
 We discussed the importance of early detection, expanding access to resources, and finding ways to better support patients and caregivers.

I passed my Federal Scholarship Tax Credit to expand educational opportunities for ALL students.

Now, with @USTreasury’s guidance, married couples filing jointly can claim up to $3,400—not just $1,700. Opening the door to more than $75 billion in potential scholarship donations! https://t.co/GnuUQgK3cm

Congratulations to my fellow Nebraskan, Greg Ibach, on his nomination to serve as Under Secretary for Trade and Foreign Agricultural Affairs at @USDA. Greg has always fought for Nebraska’s agriculture producers, and I know he’ll bring that same dedication to this important role.

Strong IP protections are critical to American innovation and competitiveness.
 
Yesterday, I sent a letter to @USTradeRep supporting strong IP commitments in new trade agreements and enforcement of existing commitments under USMCA.
 
Proud to support American innovation. https://t.co/A3gOjdIlmb

September 30, 2026 marks 50 years of the Hyde Amendment.

In my latest column, I reflect on its legacy and why supporting mothers and families go hand in hand with protecting the unborn.

Read more:
https://t.co/b6AAD4pD4H

Want to learn more about our government, hear different perspectives, and make your voice heard? Apply to join my Youth Advisory Council for the 2026–27 school year.

Apply by Sept. 25:
https://t.co/hyDgPDt7Rx

My staff will be hosting a mobile office hour tomorrow, September 22nd, for constituents in Chase County. 

If you have thoughts to share or need assistance with a federal agency, please stop by to see how my office can help!

My staff will be hosting a mobile office hour tomorrow, September 21st, for constituents in Dundy County.

If you have thoughts to share or need assistance with a federal agency, please stop by to see how my office can help!

 https://t.co/xMI78Z1rwA

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
